findings.description: [Band 1 Desktop — top-right Discord presence line, dark & light] Pinning only the sync timestamp flush-right created a ~95px empty gulf between 'Discord Offline' and '· last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST', leaving an orphaned leading middot attached to 'last synced' (v8 #3 regressed). This breaks the Discord status reading on desktop even though the avatar + hollow offline ring itself reads clearly. Direction: keep status head and sync detail as one cohesive right-aligned unit (e.g., render 'Offline · last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' as a single right-anchored <text> with <tspan> weight/color contrast and place the Discord mark via tight measured offset, or stack 'last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST' directly beneath right-aligned 'Discord Offline').

[Band 1 Desktop — middle-right meta stats block, dark & light] Justifying 5 stats across 3+2 lines leaves a ~170px hollow void in the middle of row 2 between '4,637 issues' and 'top 46% on GitHub', breaks vertical column alignment ('16,743 commits' has nothing beneath it and 'top 46% on GitHub' sits left of '5,432 PRs'), and terminates ~25-40px short of the right margin (v8 #3 unresolved). Direction: replace justified line-wrapping with a fixed-column 2x2 grid aligned cleanly to the right margin once the 5th stat is removed.

[Band 1 All — meta stats content, desktop & mobile, dark & light] Featuring an award-ribbon icon next to 'top 46% on GitHub' actively undermines the profile's strong narrative ('35,303 ALL-TIME CONTRIBUTIONS', '206 DAY STREAK', '16,743 commits')—'top 46%' reads as barely above median / C-grade rather than an achievement. Direction: drop the GitHub rank percentile entirely and retain the 4 complementary, non-conflicting stats (stars, commits, PRs, issues), which also resolves the awkward 5-item orphan wrapping across both breakpoints.

[Band 2 All — REPO OUTPUT bar chart, desktop & mobile, dark & light] Full-width background track rails behind max-normalized commit bars make the top repo ('FlashBeat', 2.1k commits) read at first glance as a 100%-complete progress bar, forcing viewers to read the tiny 'bar = commits · full = 2.1k' legend manual to undo a misleading encoding (v8 #7 only partially resolved). Direction: remove the background rails completely and render bare horizontal magnitude bars from a clean left baseline (optionally with a hairline zero-axis) so relative commit volume is immediately honest and self-explanatory without a track affordance.

[Band 1 Mobile — meta stats row 2, dark & light] 'top 46% on GitHub' is shifted ~15px right of '16,743 commits' above it because '4,637 issues' is wider than '174 stars' in a flow row (v8 #8 unresolved). Direction: lay out the meta stats on fixed column x-coordinates (a 2x2 grid once 'top 46%' is dropped) so columns align vertically on mobile as well as desktop.

[Band 3 Desktop — INFRA & DEV TOOLS bottom-right lane, dark & light] Vertically centering the 28px substrate chips inside the 40px row box of 'FRAMEWORKS & RUNTIMES' leaves a visibly looser gap (~18-20px vs ~10-12px on the other three lanes) below the 'INFRA & DEV TOOLS' label and floats its bottom edge ~6px above '.NET' (v8 #5 label-gap issue unresolved). Direction: top-align the 28px chip row to the exact same label-to-chip vertical offset used by 'FRAMEWORKS & RUNTIMES' so all four lane headers bind tightly to their icons.

[Band 2 All — RECENT PUBLIC EVENTS feed, desktop & mobile, dark & light] Every row repeats 'Nov 24' and 'JST' (6x desktop, 4x mobile) despite the section header already declaring 'observed Nov 24 · 09:00 JST', and inline timestamps after variable-length repo names jitter horizontally instead of scanning cleanly; also note punctuation mismatch ('Nov 24 · 09:00 JST' in header vs 'Nov 24 02:46 JST' in events). On desktop, the 2-column vertical-flow order puts '+23 more' under column 1 rather than after the chronological end in column 2, with wide uneven trailing whitespace. Direction: drop repeated 'JST' (and repeated date when matching the observed day, or align compact timestamps to the right edge of each event column), unify date/time punctuation across Band 1 and Band 2, and anchor '+23 more' cleanly at the feed footer.

[Verified v8 resolutions & strengths — all bands] Resolved cleanly: Band 3 full-opacity vibrant chips (v8 #1), Band 1 desktop left-anchored hero KPIs with tight icon spacing (v8 #2), Band 3 mobile 42/30px edge-to-edge lanes with zero dead right margin (v8 #4), Band 3 desktop flush right margins across lanes (v8 #5 partial), Band 2 unified legends, prominent weight-700 Total line, and aligned mobile commits|PRs columns (v8 #7 partial). Overall visual language is admirably restrained, unboxed, and GitHub-native across dark and light modes, with Band 3 mobile and Band 1 mobile very close to ship-ready. Minor data-clarity polish: showing 'Private repos (8)' in Band 2 would make the '38 active repos' sum explicitly self-auditing alongside 'Other public (25)'.

verdict.summary: REQUEST CHANGES. While v9 lands major wins—Band 3's full-opacity chips and edge-to-edge mobile 42/30px lanes look sharp, Band 1 desktop's left-anchored hero KPIs fix the floating icon, and Band 2's mobile sub-columns and bold Total line improve scannability—three high-impact issues prevent approval on a personal profile I would admire. First-glance comprehension and GitHub-native restraint are strong overall (unboxed layout, honest Discord offline ring + sync timestamp, clear designer-developer identity), and mobile height/legibility at 400px is well-judged, but Band 1 desktop regressed on two layout fronts and introduced a self-undermining metric, while Band 2 retains a progress-bar encoding flaw. Top 3 changes (ranked): (1) Reunite Band 1 desktop's Discord presence ('Discord Offline' and 'last synced Nov 24 · 22:46 JST') into one cohesive right-aligned cluster to eliminate the ~95px chasm and orphaned middot; (2) Remove 'top 46% on GitHub' (which contradicts 35,303 contributions and a 206-day streak) and put the remaining 4 stats (stars, commits, PRs, issues) in a clean, column-aligned 2x2 grid on both desktop and mobile; (3) Remove the full-width background rails in Band 2 REPO OUTPUT so the top repo reads honestly as a magnitude bar rather than a 100%-complete progress bar, and declutter repeated 'Nov 24 ... JST' stamps in RECENT PUBLIC EVENTS.
